We are modernizing Ethiopia's Logistics! | Garri is a digital frieght transport and brokerage company with the mission of removing the hassle and pain from freight logistics by optimizing and digitizing every aspect of the job. We offer unparalleled customer service using dedicated account managers and access to state of the art technology including live cargo tracking, frequent status updates, analytics, and many more.
